subject: Q3 executive hiring: approval matrix and comp-band exceptions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Chen <diane.chen@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 exec hires: initial ask + comp-band exceptions

Team —

Attached is the consolidated ask for three executive-level roles we want to commit to for Q3: CPO (1 FTE), Head of Reliability (1 FTE), Senior Director, GTM (1 FTE). High-level points: 

- Headcount and timing: we propose offers issued end of July with start windows Sep–Oct for all three.
- Budget impact: total run-rate delta (salary + fully-loaded benefits) ~ $1.95M/year if all roles are hired at midpoint bands; spreadsheet includes best/worst case.
- Comp band exceptions: the CPO req seeks a band exception for base up to $420k + 5% sign-on (band cap currently $380k). We flagged this in comp-band-exceptions-log.csv.

Action requested:
1) Finance/exec sign-off on band exception for CPO (yes/no + any conditions).
2) Authorize offer authority and initial offer ranges for Head of Reliability and Sr Dir GTM.
3) Confirm we can proceed with parallel candidate submittals through BluePeak (cc'd) so we don't lose momentum.

Attachments: Q3_exec_hc_request_v3.xlsx, CPO_role_brief_v1.pdf, comp-band-exceptions-log.csv

Thanks — aiming for a short decision window so recruiters can lock candidates.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 exec hires: initial ask + comp-band exceptions

Thanks for the clear packet, Soojin. A few quick items from finance/strategy perspective: 

- Need the expected annualized cost broken out by cash comp / equity / expected sign-on separately per role (spreadsheet column currently aggregates). Can you update the sheet?
- If we approve the CPO band exception, will that set a precedent for other late-stage exec requisitions this year? I want to understand guardrails (e.g., must be approved by CEO + CFO, and limited to X/year).
- Suggest phasing the Senior Dir GTM into Q4 hiring unless we have a prioritized quota-bearing pipeline that requires Sep start. This preserves Q3 budget headroom.

Assuming those clarifications, I can greenlight the CPO band exception for recruitment to extend offers at up to $420k base contingent on CEO sign-off and a final compensation memo.

If we can get the updated cost split by EOD Wednesday I can present to the CFO in the Thursday budget sync.

— Vivek
CEO Office
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Diane Chen <diane.chen@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 exec hires: initial ask + comp-band exceptions

Appreciate the packet. From People ops side: 

- Comp bands & approvals: the Compensation Committee meets Wednesday 2027-06-16 at 10:00 PT. If we want the exception to be actionable this cycle, we must have:
  * Finalized role brief for CPO (incl. scope and direct reports) — CPO_role_brief_v1.pdf mostly complete but add org map.
  * A completed comp memo (recommendation + comparable comps) — use OfferApprovalForm-Template link in related_links.

- Equity and sign-on: propose 12–16% of total comp delivered as RSUs over 4 years for CPO with double-trigger vesting for change-in-control. Approvals for equity above 15% will need board notification.

- Candidate logistics: Diane, please confirm candidate ETA for final rounds and any ask for an accelerated package.

I'll prepare a short approval memo tonight; Soojin please update the spreadsheet with cash/equity split so I can attach it to the committee packet.

— Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Diane Chen <diane.chen@bluepeak.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 exec hires: initial ask + comp-band exceptions

On behalf of BluePeak — quick update on candidate flow for CPO: 

- We have two active final-stage candidates: Candidate A (ex-SaaS VP Product) expecting 390–430k base range; Candidate B (ex-marketplace leader) expecting 410–440k base and heavier equity ask.
- Both can compress rounds to complete on a two-week timeline if Redwood is able to confirm top-of-band authority and provide a draft offer letter (we can accept draft by EOD Wednesday).
- Attached: candidate comp expectation summary (we'll push final CVs once we get go-ahead).

We will await confirmation of whether the board notice trigger applies (per Laura's note) before we proceed with final offers.

— Diane
Principal, BluePeak Executive Search
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Chen <diane.chen@bluepeak.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 exec hires: initial ask + comp-band exceptions — consolidated ask for sign-off

Folks — quick consolidation after the committee and recruiter notes: 

- Action items I am requesting now: 
  1) Vivek: provisional executive approval for the CPO band exception at up to $420k base (you already signaled conditional ok) — final CEO sign-off requested by Thu morning.
  2) Laura: include the comp memo + org map in the committee packet and confirm if RSU plan needs board notification (Laura to advise).
  3) Marcus (Sales): confirm if SR Dir GTM can be deferred to Q4; please reply with one-line yes/no.

- I updated Q3_exec_hc_request_v3.xlsx to break out cash vs equity vs sign-on in separate columns (drive link in related_links).
- Recruiter note: BluePeak can present final offers on a compressed timeline provided we confirm top-of-band authority by Thursday EOD.

If we can close this by Friday, we should be able to have candidate start windows in Sep without impacting Q3 deliverables. Please reply with explicit approvals or edits so I can draft formal offer letters.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
